findings.summary: Acceptance requires a migration adding `agents.reporter_tier`, and `database.types.ts` / all tier readers already assume that column, but no migration under `supabase/migrations` mentions `reporter_tier` (unlike `x_accounts.tier`).
findings.scenario: Deploy from migrations only → PostgREST rejects every `select`/`update` of `reporter_tier` (feed page, extraction, pipeline, editDraft, post-core) → feed hits `notFound()` on agent load and desk tier never persists, so premium-reporter desks stay capped by the posting account.

findings.summary: Generated types list `agents.reporter_tier: string | null` with no corresponding schema migration in-repo, so the type mirror does not reflect a shippable DB state from this delta alone.
findings.scenario: Typecheck/build pass against types that claim the column exists while a migration-only environment lacks it → runtime column errors that compile-time checks cannot catch.

findings.summary: Main drafting path calls shared `checkXPostable` with the desk-resolved tier, then on failure only logs and still crowns/delivers the winner (`insert_claimed_winner`), while editDraft and post-core block the same text.
findings.scenario: Standard-tier desk, model returns a 400-char draft → winner is stored and Slack-notified → Post stays disabled / post-core returns unpostable until a human trims.

findings.summary: Create-agent 30-character name cap is enforced only in the client form; `createDesk` accepts any non-empty trimmed name and inserts it into unconstrained `agents.name`.
findings.scenario: Direct server-action call with a 100-character name succeeds → desk switcher and workspace show an oversized label the UI claims to forbid.

findings.summary: Live under-field error and `handleSubmit` reject names over 30, but `canSubmit` only requires `name.trim().length > 0`, so Create Agent stays enabled for over-long names unlike other incomplete states.
findings.scenario: User types a 35-character agent name with beat and handles filled → button remains clickable → submit fails with form error after click.

findings.summary: Domain→`display_name` map loads every `source_configs` row for the desk (no `status = 'active'` filter) and last-write-wins by www-stripped domain with undefined order.
findings.scenario: Active config for mundodeportivo.com has `display_name` "Mundo Deportivo" and a later pending/failed row for another path on the same domain has `display_name` = hostname → feed cards for that host may show the bare hostname instead of the publication name.

findings.summary: Revision length self-check uses code-point `[...text].length` against the desk ceiling rather than shared `checkXPostable` / twitter-text weighted length (email revision path is dormant behind `EMAIL_DELIVERY_ENABLED`).
findings.scenario: If email correction is re-enabled: URL-heavy revision under 280 code points but over weighted 280 passes repair → new winner persists → post gate rejects as too long.

findings.summary: Revision path passes `resolveDeskTier` into `reviseDraft` for the prompt ceiling only and never calls `checkXPostable` before inserting the new winner (dormant email path).
findings.scenario: Email correction re-enabled; model returns invalid/control-character text that still crowns as winner → reporter cannot post until another edit path blocks or trims it.

findings.summary: Instruction map still documents only `checkXPostable` as the X gate and never mentions `agents.reporter_tier` / `resolveDeskTier`, so the desk-tier contract that this delta makes load-bearing is absent from the binding code map.
findings.scenario: A later change wires a winner writer using `resolveXTier(account.tier)` alone, reintroducing the 280 cap on premium-reporter override desks that this work intended to remove.

findings.summary: `getDraftReasoning` returns `found` (and thus loads construction) only when an on-beat reason resolves; construction on the same model call is unreachable if beat provenance is missing.
findings.scenario: Row has valid `usage.draftConstruction` but empty/missing `draftOnBeatReason` and no legacy "On beat: yes —" line → Reasoning sheet shows unavailable/none and never renders How Oparax built the draft.

findings.summary: Malformed or partial model `construction` is dropped via `safeParse` with no log/metric; the draft still wins and the sheet only shows "Construction details were not recorded."
findings.scenario: Model omits `version: 1` or returns empty `appliedRules` → draft posts fine → reporter never sees post mode / rules / formatting account for that delivery.

findings.summary: Extract Voice From (admin-only) uses instructional placeholder `"handle without the @"` while DESIGN/acceptance require placeholders to be examples only.
findings.scenario: Admin clears the default ReshadRahman value → field shows an instruction-as-placeholder instead of e.g. `e.g. ReshadRahman`.

findings.summary: Excluded cards still label website sources with www-stripped hostname only (no `display_name`, no 15px favicon), diverging from the feed strip naming this delta introduced.
findings.scenario: Same Mundo Deportivo article: Feed shows "Mundo Deportivo" with favicon; Excluded shows `mundodeportivo.com` with globe sizing that does not match the 15px feed slot.

findings.summary: Third-party favicon `` loads `origin/favicon.ico` without `referrerPolicy="no-referrer"`, so opening the feed can send the app Referer to publisher origins.
findings.scenario: Reporter opens feed of tracked news sites → browser GETs each site's favicon with Referer containing `/agents/<desk-id>/…`.

findings.summary: Prop comment still says the ceiling comes from the posting account via `resolveXTier` in page.tsx; feed actually uses `resolveDeskTier(agent.reporter_tier, xLink.tier)`.
findings.scenario: A future change "restores account-tier ceiling for Post" based on this comment re-breaks premium-reporter / free-posting-account desks.

findings.summary: Comment claims the submit check is a belt for the Input's `maxLength`, but `maxLength` was removed from the name field per acceptance.
findings.scenario: Implementer re-adds `maxLength={30}` to match the stale comment, undoing the live-error-only design.
